_about: Hand-maintained. Each entry is one Google ad a person checked: the adstransparency.google.com ad page and advertiser page (legal name + FEC ID), then fec.gov (committee record; independent expenditures filed against the PA-Sen 2024 candidates). make ads merges these into ads.json as `verification`. Never generated.

verifications.note: Ad page: WINSENATE, video, Sep 18-Oct 8 2024, $500K-$600K, over 10M impressions, location Pennsylvania. Advertiser page: legal name WINSENATE, FEC ID C00865444. fec.gov: WINSENATE, Super PAC (independent expenditure-only), ID C00865444; 100+ processed IE rows for/against McCormick (S2PA00661) and Casey (S6PA00217) in 2023-2024. Google shows no separate 'Paid for by' line for US advertisers; the legal name + FEC ID on the advertiser page is the disclosure read.

Ad page: SENATE LEADERSHIP FUND, video, Oct 3-11 2024, $300K-$350K, over 10M impressions, location Pennsylvania. Advertiser page: legal name SENATE LEADERSHIP FUND, FEC ID C00571703. fec.gov: SENATE LEADERSHIP FUND, Super PAC (independent expenditure-only), ID C00571703; 74 processed IE rows opposing Casey in 2023-2024.

Ad page: AMERICANS FOR PROSPERITY ACTION INC, video, Jun 4-Jul 7 2024, $60K-$70K, 4M-4.5M impressions, location Pennsylvania. Advertiser page lists the legal name with an EIN (83-1800586), not an FEC ID, so the name was matched to fec.gov by hand: AMERICANS FOR PROSPERITY ACTION, INC. (AFP ACTION) DBA CVA ACTION AND DBA LIBRE ACTION, ID C00687103; 178 processed IE rows for/against McCormick and Casey in 2023-2024. Name-only link on the Google side; the FEC ID itself is not printed by Google for this advertiser.

Ad page: KEYSTONE RENEWAL PAC, video, Aug 19-27 2024, $60K-$70K, 4M-4.5M impressions, PA postal codes included. Advertiser page: legal name KEYSTONE RENEWAL PAC, FEC ID C00849489. fec.gov: KEYSTONE RENEWAL PAC, ID C00849489; 90 processed IE rows supporting McCormick in 2023-2024.

Ad page: DSCC, video, Aug 20-Sep 16 2024, $125K-$150K, 3.5M-4M impressions, PA postal codes (15104 and 10 others). Advertiser page: legal name DSCC, FEC ID C00042366. fec.gov: DSCC, ID C00042366; 37 processed IE rows opposing McCormick in 2023-2024.
